extraction.text:
VAIBHAV WAGHMARE

Senior Fund Accountant | Daily NAV & Checker Sign-Off · Reconciliation · Multi-Asset Portfolio Accounting

+91 9145635599  · wvaibhav91@gmail.com · Pune, Maharashtra 411020 · Open to relocation linkedin.com/in/vaibhav-waghmare-7a54a41a6

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Senior Fund Accountant with 4+ years in fund accounting and loan operations, including 3+ years of daily NAV computation and checker sign-off for multi-asset institutional funds with AUM of USD 500M–4B, across fund of funds, master-feeder, closed-ended and open-ended structures, plus a year in syndicated bank loan operations. Hands-on across the full GAV to NAV process, month-end and year-end close, and GAAP/IFRS financial statements, working within maker-checker controls and each fund's governing documents. CFA Level I candidate with working knowledge of hedge fund and private equity fund accounting. Immediate joiner with nil notice period; open to Pune, Mumbai, Bengaluru and Hyderabad.

CORE SKILLS

Fund Accounting: Daily NAV Computation & Checker Sign-Off · Cash, Position & GL Reconciliation & Break Resolution · Independent Price Verification · Fair Value Hierarchy (ASC 820 / IFRS 13) · Corporate Actions · Subscriptions, Redemptions & Capital Activity · Fee & Expense Accruals · Month-End / Year-End Close · Financial Statements (GAAP / IFRS) · Internal Controls, Operational Risk & Audit Support · UAT & Process Improvement

Fund Structures & Assets: Fund of Funds · Master-Feeder · Open-Ended · Closed-Ended · SPVs · Multi-Class Share Class Structures · GP/LP Structures · Equities · Fixed Income · Derivatives (Exchange-Traded & OTC) · FX Forwards · Syndicated Bank Loans

Alternatives & Private Credit: Hedge Fund & Private Equity Fund Accounting · Syndicated Loan & Private Credit Administration · Drawdowns, Rollovers & Paydowns · Commitment Tracking · NAV Equalisation & High Water Marks · Management & Incentive Fees · Capital Calls, Distributions & Carried Interest Waterfalls · Investor Allocations · IRR, TVPI, DPI, MOIC · ASC 946 Financial Statements

Systems: Invest One (FIS) · Fund Master Custody · TLMP · IDS · OWM · Bloomberg Terminal · Wall Street Office (WSO) · Loan IQ (LIQ) · Advanced Excel

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Senior Fund Accountant | Fund Accountant — Northern Trust · Pune, India

Apr 2023 – Jun 2026

Promoted to Senior Fund Accountant in Jan 2026

Owned daily NAV computation and checker sign-off for 5–8 institutional funds, AUM USD 500M–4B, including closed-ended and fund of funds vehicles, reviewing 50+ transactions a day under the GAV/NAV operating procedure and maker-checker controls.

Reconciled cash, positions and general ledger daily against custodian and broker records, clearing breaks ahead of NAV release with 100% completion within SLA and escalating aged items with root-cause commentary.

Redesigned the monthly management, custody and expense fee process to remove manual handoffs, postings and repeat calculations, cutting processing time by 50% against the earlier manual routine, and took part in user acceptance testing before rollout.

Led month-end and year-end close for 3+ clients, covering GAAP and IFRS financial statements, trial balance review, disclosure validation and audit coordination.

Acted as first point of contact for escalations on allocated funds, and issued daily NAV packs, NAV reports and benchmark reports to clients and the home-location team within agreed timelines.

Ran independent price verification against Bloomberg and third-party vendor feeds, and assessed and booked corporate actions — dividends, mergers, rights issues, capital reductions and restructures — ahead of ex-date, evaluating the NAV and financial statement impact of each.

Processed subscriptions and redemptions with daily reconciliation of the transfer agent registry report, and handled ex-dividend valuation, income distribution, share class accounting and daily FX forward and hedge verification across multi-currency portfolios.

Built and maintained detailed SOPs for 2 clients, and supported onboarding of 2–3 new funds, fund launches and system migrations on Invest One, covering static data setup, opening balance validation and post-migration reconciliation.

Calculated, reviewed and posted Management Fee, Performance Fee, Incentive Fee, Custody Fee and Fund Expense accruals in accordance with fund governing documents and client-specific fee arrangements.

Performed Management Fee and Performance Fee accounting, including accruals, equalisation adjustments, High Water Mark (HWM) calculations and fee validations before NAV release.

Validated management and performance fee calculations against fund documentation, ensuring accurate accounting treatment and timely reflection in daily and periodic NAV.

Reviewed fee calculations, expense allocations and accruals during month-end and year-end close, ensuring compliance with GAAP/IFRS and fund accounting policies.

Managed end-to-end trade lifecycle activities including trade validation, booking verification, settlement validation, and post-trade reconciliation across multi-asset institutional portfolios.

Performed Cash, Position, Market Value and Holdings Reconciliation between accounting books, custodians, brokers and portfolio records, ensuring timely resolution of exceptions prior to NAV release.

Investigated NAV, pricing, trade and reconciliation breaks by coordinating with Custodians, Investment Managers, Brokers and Transfer Agents, ensuring all exceptions were resolved within agreed SLAs.

Performed daily Custodian Reconciliation, validating cash balances, security holdings, corporate actions and settlement activities to maintain portfolio accuracy.

Validated security prices using Bloomberg and third-party market data vendors, resolving stale prices, pricing exceptions and valuation discrepancies before NAV finalization.

Verified investment transactions across Equities, Fixed Income, Derivatives and FX instruments to ensure accurate accounting, valuation and financial reporting.

Partnered with Fund Managers, Custodians, Transfer Agents, Pricing Vendors, Internal Operations and Audit teams to resolve operational issues and support timely NAV production.

Ensured adherence to fund governing documents, client-specific accounting policies, internal controls, operational risk frameworks and maker-checker governance throughout the NAV production process.

Supported new fund launches, portfolio transitions and system migrations by performing static data validation, opening balance verification, portfolio reconciliation and post-migration quality checks.

Contributed to continuous process improvement initiatives by standardizing operational procedures, enhancing reconciliation controls and improving overall NAV production efficiency.

Analyst, Syndicated Loan & Settlement Operations (Private Credit) — eClerx ( client _ Morgan Stanley ) · Pune, India 

Apr 2022 – Mar 2023

Administered syndicated bank loan and private credit facilities on Loan IQ (LIQ) and Wall Street Office (WSO), processing drawdowns, rollovers, paydowns, commitment adjustments and trade settlement notices across the facility lifecycle.

Calculated interest accruals and fee figures across multiple tranches, validating each against the agent bank's notice before processing.

Cleared cash settlement breaks against tight cutoffs, coordinating directly with counterparties and keeping internal controls documentation current.

Managed trade settlement activities across the syndicated loan lifecycle, validating settlement instructions, cash movements and transaction processing within defined cut-off timelines.

Investigated settlement exceptions, cash breaks and transaction discrepancies by coordinating with Agent Banks, Counterparties and Internal Operations teams to ensure accurate settlement processing.

Performed interest accrual validation, fee verification and commitment reconciliation across multiple syndicated loan facilities while maintaining compliance with internal controls and operational procedures.

KEY ACHIEVEMENTS

Zero missed NAV or reporting deadlines in 3+ years at Northern Trust, across every quarter-end and year-end close while running multiple client portfolios in parallel.

Promoted from Fund Accountant to Senior Fund Accountant within three years, on the strength of NAV accuracy, reconciliation ownership and audit support quality.

Trained and mentored new joiners on NAV production, reconciliation and maker-checker control procedures.

EDUCATION & CERTIFICATIONS

Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com) — Ness Wadia College of Commerce, Pune (74.17%) · 2021

CFA Level I Candidate — CFA Institute (in progress)
